facts.fact: The Independent, citing the IRAS website, says IRAS was rolled out in 98 districts, 21 municipalities and 9 cities (128 local governments) at a cost of UGX 20.07 billion to date; no national total is given. Date is the article's March 2024.
The article says the Ministry of Local Government's E-LogRev was operational in 48 local governments; no total is given. Date is the article's March 2024.

The Auditor General's report on FY2022/23, quoted here, counts 124 activated local governments, 39 of which lacked enough phones, laptops, printers and POS machines to operate the revenue system; no national total is given.

Nansana's mayor says the system fixes assessment so that no assessor discretion enters, helps taxpayers keep records and records payments against a catalogue of fees, with an undefined 'other revenue' line open to under-recording; article of March 2024.

The Ministry of Local Government runs E-LogRev, which the article describes as the ministry's initiative alongside IRAS, introduced from 2017 under the government's automation of local revenue systems.

systems.tiers: 98 districts, 21 municipalities, 9 cities per the IRAS website; Nansana Municipal Council and Masaka City cited
